Module be.kdg.programming.integrationproject
Package be.kdg.programming.integrationproject.view.game

Class GamePresenter

java.lang.Object
be.kdg.programming.integrationproject.view.game.GamePresenter
public class GamePresenter extends Object
Top-level gameplay controller anchoring the MVP game architecture. Manages player actions, synchronizes database states, controls automated CPU workflows, and checks game-end victory parameters.
Version:
